purpose: Curated directory of external data sources for students and collaborators. These datasets are not produced, owned, or redistributed by Elmer Quispe-Salazar.

resources.name: FAO FishStatJ
resources.description: FAO fisheries and aquaculture statistical time series covering production, capture, trade and related sector statistics.
resources.use_case: Global catch and production trends, comparative fisheries analyses, teaching with official fisheries statistics.
resources.terms: FAO terms and citation guidance apply; source workspaces are updated by FAO.

resources.name: Global Fishing Watch
resources.formats: REST API / R / Python / CSV / JSON
resources.description: AIS- and partnership-derived vessel identity, fishing activity, events and related ocean-transparency products.
resources.use_case: Fishing effort, fleet dynamics, vessel behaviour, spatial pressure indicators and reproducible vessel analyses.
resources.terms: Account and API token required. Most APIs are for non-commercial use and require attribution; some datasets need additional approval.

resources.name: Sea Around Us
resources.coverage: Global / EEZ / LME / RFMO / high seas
resources.description: Reconstructed fisheries catch data and contextual fisheries indicators organized by taxa, fishing country and marine regions.
resources.use_case: Historical catch reconstruction, spatial fisheries comparisons, teaching on reported versus reconstructed catches.
resources.terms: Use the project methods, caveats and citation guidance; large or specialized extracts may require contacting the project.

resources.name: RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database
resources.description: Compilation of stock-assessment outputs for commercially exploited marine populations, with archived releases on Zenodo.
resources.use_case: Cross-stock comparisons, biomass and fishing-mortality trajectories, stock-status research and teaching.
resources.terms: Use the versioned release citation and database documentation.

resources.name: ICES DATRAS
resources.provider: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea
resources.description: Trawl-survey data products and raw survey data contributed by national programmes and coordinated through ICES.
resources.use_case: Survey indices, length and age compositions, spatial survey analysis, calibration and teaching.
resources.terms: ICES open-data policy applies; open-access DATRAS data are provided under CC BY 4.0 with dataset acknowledgements.

resources.name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS)
resources.formats: GeoParquet / TSV / API / R / Darwin Core
resources.description: Integrated marine species occurrence and event records harvested from thousands of datasets.
resources.use_case: Species-distribution modelling, biodiversity mapping, occurrence QC, biogeography and ecological baselines.
resources.terms: Underlying dataset licences vary (for example CC0, CC BY and CC BY-NC); users must cite the contributing datasets.

resources.name: GBIF
resources.formats: API / CSV / Darwin Core Archive / Parquet / DOI downloads
resources.description: Global biodiversity occurrence records and taxonomic information from participating institutions and publishers.
resources.use_case: Species occurrences, ecological niche modelling, distribution validation and biodiversity synthesis.
resources.terms: Dataset-level licences apply. Registered bulk downloads receive persistent download metadata and citation information.

resources.name: Bio-ORACLE
resources.description: Standardized physical, chemical, biological and topographic marine layers designed for ecological modelling.
resources.use_case: Species-distribution models, ecological niche modelling, environmental screening and biodiversity projections.
resources.terms: Use the dataset version and citation specified by Bio-ORACLE.

resources.name: Copernicus Marine Service
resources.formats: NetCDF / Zarr / CSV / Parquet / Python API / CLI
resources.description: Physical, biogeochemical, wave, sea-ice and ocean-monitoring products from observations and models.
resources.use_case: SST, salinity, currents, oxygen, chlorophyll, productivity, sea level, habitat modelling and ocean diagnostics.
resources.terms: Registration is free. Product licences and attribution requirements apply.

resources.name: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP
resources.description: Consistent remote access to gridded and tabular oceanographic datasets from NOAA CoastWatch nodes.
resources.use_case: SST, ocean colour, salinity, winds and reproducible R/Python subsetting without downloading full archives.
resources.terms: Dataset-specific licences and caveats are exposed through ERDDAP metadata.

resources.name: Argo GDAC
resources.description: Official Argo profile, trajectory, metadata and technical files from the Global Data Assembly Centres.
resources.use_case: Vertical temperature and salinity structure, water masses, mixed-layer studies and validation of models or satellites.
resources.terms: Use official quality-control flags and cite Argo data according to programme guidance.

resources.name: World Ocean Database
resources.description: Large, uniformly formatted and quality-controlled collection of ocean profile observations from many platforms and programmes.
resources.use_case: Historical hydrography, CTD/XBT profiles, long-term change, validation and climatology construction.
resources.terms: Public use without restriction; citation is requested.

resources.name: World Ocean Atlas
resources.description: Objectively analysed climatological fields for temperature, salinity, oxygen, nutrients and related ocean variables.
resources.use_case: Environmental baselines, climatologies, anomaly calculation, model validation and teaching.
resources.terms: Public use without restriction; citation is requested.

resources.name: NASA Ocean Biology DAAC (Ocean Color)
resources.description: Multi-mission archive of ocean colour, sea-surface temperature, sea-surface salinity and supporting in-situ SeaBASS observations.
resources.use_case: Chlorophyll, optical properties, productivity proxies, pelagic habitat, fronts and satellite validation.
resources.terms: NASA Earthdata account may be required for download services; mission-specific citation and data-use guidance apply.

resources.name: NOAA OISST v2.1
resources.description: Daily blended sea-surface temperature Climate Data Record combining satellite and in-situ observations on a complete grid.
resources.use_case: SST anomalies, marine heatwaves, ENSO diagnostics, habitat studies and long-term environmental covariates.
resources.terms: Public NOAA Climate Data Record; cite the dataset and associated methodology.

resources.name: ERA5
resources.description: Global atmospheric reanalysis with hourly surface, atmospheric and wave variables.
resources.use_case: Wind, heat fluxes, pressure, waves, precipitation, atmospheric forcing and climate covariates.
resources.terms: CDS account and acceptance of dataset licence are required; ERA5 is distributed under CC BY terms in the current CDS record.

resources.name: HadISST1
resources.access: Open / registration for some subset services
resources.description: Long-term monthly sea-surface temperature and sea-ice concentration analysis.
resources.use_case: Historical SST variability, climate indices, regime analysis and century-scale environmental context.
resources.terms: Provider terms and citation guidance apply; some CEDA subset services require registration.

resources.name: NOAA PSL Climate Indices
resources.coverage: Global climate indices / monthly time series
resources.description: Collection of atmospheric and ocean climate indices including Niño 1+2, Niño 3.4, ONI, MEI and PDO-related series.
resources.use_case: ENSO and climate-regime classification, environmental context, teaching and covariate construction.
resources.terms: Check each index source, update status and caveats before analysis; cite the originating time series.

resources.name: GEBCO Grid
resources.description: Global gridded terrain model for ocean and land with annual releases and source-type information.
resources.use_case: Bathymetry, slope, spatial modelling covariates, terrain context and oceanographic map backgrounds.
resources.terms: The GEBCO Grid is public domain and free to use; attribution is requested.

resources.name: Marine Regions
resources.description: Authoritative downloadable marine geographic boundaries including EEZs, territorial seas, high seas and related marine regions.
resources.use_case: EEZ assignment, marine-region overlays, spatial stratification and fisheries-area mapping.
resources.terms: Current downloadable boundary products use provider-specific attribution terms; many are CC BY 4.0. Download from the source rather than redistributing copies.

resources.name: PRODUCE Open Data catalogue
resources.description: National open-data catalogue containing fisheries, aquaculture, landing infrastructure, vessel and production datasets from PRODUCE and related agencies.
resources.use_case: Peruvian fisheries context, teaching datasets, public-sector indicators and reproducible national case studies.
resources.terms: Individual datasets state their licence and update frequency; many fisheries datasets use the Open Data Commons Attribution License.

resources.name: IMARPE coastal sea-surface temperature
resources.coverage: Peruvian coastal laboratories / 1970-Jul 2026 in current release
resources.description: Daily sea-surface temperature observations measured at IMARPE coastal laboratory stations.
resources.use_case: Coastal thermal variability, climatologies, anomaly studies, teaching and validation of gridded SST products.
resources.terms: Open Data Commons Attribution License in the national open-data record; use the current release metadata and citation.

resources.name: IMARPE coastal sea-surface salinity
resources.coverage: Peruvian coastal laboratories / 1995-Jan 2026 in current release
resources.description: Daily sea-surface salinity observations measured at IMARPE coastal laboratory stations.
resources.use_case: Coastal salinity variability, freshwater influence, climatologies and validation of ocean products.
resources.terms: Open Data Commons Attribution License in the national open-data record; use the current release metadata and citation.

resources.name: Peruvian anchoveta landings (anonymized)
resources.description: Anonymized landing records for anchoveta for indirect human consumption, with port, vessel-regime and landing information.
resources.use_case: Landing dynamics, port-level analyses, fishery timing, teaching and reproducible Peruvian anchoveta examples.
resources.terms: Open Data Commons Attribution License; quarterly catalogue updates and anonymization rules apply.

resources.name: Peruvian fishing-vessel satellite transmissions
resources.description: Anonymized satellite transmissions processed by Peru's fishing-vessel monitoring system (SISESAT).
resources.use_case: Fleet movement, spatial fishing pressure, vessel behaviour exercises and comparison with AIS-derived products.
resources.terms: Open Data Commons Attribution License in the published national open-data record; inspect temporal completeness before analysis.

resources.name: Peruvian fishing landing infrastructure
resources.description: Georeferenced catalogue of fishing ports, artisanal landing sites, coves and related hydrobiological landing infrastructure.
resources.use_case: Port networks, landing-site accessibility, spatial fisheries context and teaching.
resources.terms: Open Data Commons Attribution License in the national open-data record.

resources.name: MarineTraffic / Kpler AIS Data API
resources.description: Commercial AIS and maritime-intelligence services providing vessel positions, voyages and related vessel information.
resources.use_case: High-frequency vessel tracking, maritime traffic analysis and projects requiring commercial AIS coverage or service levels.
resources.terms: API key and commercial licence are required; redistribution and downstream use are governed by Kpler/MarineTraffic terms.

resources.name: Spire Maritime AIS
resources.description: Commercial satellite and terrestrial AIS products with current and historical vessel position and voyage data.
resources.use_case: Global vessel tracking, historical tracks, maritime analytics and projects requiring commercial satellite AIS.
resources.terms: Customer agreement and product-specific licensing apply.

resources.name: Planet Education & Research imagery
resources.access: Academic application / restricted licence / paid tiers
resources.description: PlanetScope and RapidEye imagery available through education and research programmes, with additional paid research tiers.
resources.use_case: High-resolution coastal mapping, habitat change, shoreline analysis, remote-sensing coursework and research.
resources.terms: University-affiliated users may apply for limited non-commercial access. Raw imagery cannot generally be redistributed publicly under the academic licence.
